subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServe Corp
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@finserve.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finserve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServe Corp

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through the Redwood demo. It was great to see how you're thinking about integrating LLM assist into your claims intake and routing workflows. To keep momentum, I wanted to capture the recap and propose a lightweight POC plan you can review with your team.

Quick recap from our call:
- Goal: Reduce manual triage time and improve routing accuracy for incoming claims using a lightweight LLM pipeline (extractions + routing suggestions).
- Key stakeholders: Oliver (Product), Priya (SRE), Maria Chen (Head of Claims, not on call today).
- Success signals discussed: 20%+ reduction in triage latency; 15% increase in correct routing to specialist queues; integration compatibility with existing SQS + internal audit logging.

Attached: "FinServe_evaluation-outline.pdf" — a short evaluation outline with success criteria, suggested test data, and acceptance metrics. Also included a proposed timeline spreadsheet (separate attachment) with owners and milestones.

Proposed high-level POC scope (2–4 weeks):
1) Sandbox setup (week 0): private test workspace, sample data ingestion, and baseline metrics capture.
2) Model integration (week 1): Redwood API endpoint + simple transformer to extract claim type + recommended routing.
3) Evaluation & quality checks (week 2): run 500–1,000 historical claims through pipeline, measure precision/recall and latency.
4) Decision demo & next steps (end of week 3/4): review results against success criteria and plan roll-forward.

Ownership (proposed):
- FinServe: provide sample labeled data, test accounts, and SQS endpoints — owner: Oliver.
- Redwood: sandbox + model endpoint, instrumentation, and evaluation report — owner: Camila.

Next steps:
- Oliver: confirm success criteria and any additional stakeholders we should include (Maria?).
- Priya: confirm security/ingress requirements for sandbox (VPC peering or secure proxy).
- Once we have that, I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff and share the Drive folder with artifacts.

If this looks good I can kick off the sandbox provision next week (target Mon 10/11).

Thanks again —

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0173

Attachments: FinServe_evaluation-outline.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); FinServe_proposed-poc-timeline.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@finserve.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finserve.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServe Corp

Camila —

Thanks for the quick recap and the outline. The scope looks reasonable and aligns with what we discussed. A couple of additional notes from our side:

- Success criteria: we want to formalize two primary metrics for the POC: (1) Triaging accuracy (top-1 correct queue) target >= 75% on the test set; (2) End-to-end median latency <= 450ms for the inference + routing step.
- Data: we can provide a curated set of ~1,200 historical claims with labels for routing. We will anonymize PII before sending; expected delivery by 10/10.
- Security: Priya will send the list of ingress IPs and whether a temporary VPN or VPC peering is required.
- Timeline: 2–3 week preferred — target decision by 10/29 to align with our Q4 roadmap.

Also looping Maria (via Priya) for visibility — she’ll want to see the evaluation criteria.

Can you confirm Redwood will enable token-level logging and provide an evaluation report with precision/recall and latency percentiles?

Oliver
Product Lead — FinServe Corp
oliver@finserve.com | (617) 555-0110

Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServe Corp

Oliver —

Perfect, thanks for the confirmation and for spelling out the hard success targets — that helps a lot. Quick answers below and next steps.

- Token-level logging & evaluation report: yes, Redwood will enable request/response logging scoped to the sandbox and provide the evaluation report with precision/recall, confusion matrix, and latency percentiles (p50/p95). We will redact any sensitive fields per your instructions.
- Data delivery: noted — we’ll expect the anonymized dataset by 10/10. We’ll validate sample formatting and send a simple ingestion template today.
- Security: Priya, if you can send the network requirements we’ll engage our infra team and propose the simplest approach (secure proxy + IP allowlist or VPC peering if required).

Attached is the updated POC timeline ("FinServe_proposed-poc-timeline.xlsx") with explicit owners and a proposed kickoff window the week of 10/11. I also added a short checklist of acceptance criteria in the Drive doc.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & scope review (5 min)
- Data delivery & ingestion steps (10 min)
- Sandbox access & security (5 min)
- Evaluation plan & reporting cadence (5 min)
- Action items & timeline (5 min)

Owner assignments (finalized):
- FinServe: Oliver (data owner), Priya (security), Maria (executive stakeholder)
- Redwood: Camila (AE & POC lead), Marissa (Solutions Engineer), Dylan (Platform contact for VPC/network)

Next steps (actionable):
1) Priya: send security/network requirements and confirm whether VPN or VPC peering is preferred (by 10/6).
2) Oliver: share anonymized dataset (by 10/10).
3) Camila/Marissa: provision sandbox and share credentials + Drive folder (target 10/11).
4) Schedule kickoff (I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-min slot the week of 10/11 once Priya confirms network approach).

If all good I’ll move forward with provisioning and post the kickoff invite this afternoon for tentative slots.

Thanks —

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: FinServe_proposed-poc-timeline.xlsx (Excel)

I'll prepare the evaluation harness and a quick runbook for the dataset ingestion (CSV template + anonymization steps). Camila — I’ll sync with you after I confirm the infra approach.

-Marissa
